text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reporter with the round glasses, who 
had been watching in secret, seemed to 
find the courage to keep doing their best 
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, while celebrating her victory, 
Matikanetannhauser promptly suggested 
their next target: the Japan Cup, where 
champions from all over the world 
gathered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have absolute confidence 
she'll win, but she wants to take on the 
challenge. Together with her... our days 
charging toward the Japan Cup begin!
